description: The wives of Stepford have a secret.

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

description: A vampire hunter (Jason Scott Lee) goes in search of medical students who hope to distill the key to immortality from the body of Dracula.

description: With help from his partner (Jason Scott Lee), a vampire hunter (Jason London) tries to save his fiancée from the evil count in Romania.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

description: Emily Brontë's Cathy (Juliette Binoche) and Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) fuel two generations of gothic romance on the Yorkshire moors.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

description: An escaped convict (Josh Brolin) convinces a lonely divorcee (Kate Winslet) and her adolescent son (Gattlin Griffith) to take him into their home.

title: The Score

title: The Crow

description: The first commercial space shuttle sends loony Ted (Robert Hays) and his former girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) on a trip to the moon.

title: What Women Want

title: Best in Show

title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
description: Siblings (Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger) learn that magical creatures are behind the strange occurrences at their great-great-uncle's rundown estate.

description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

title: Nancy Drew
description: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

description: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

title: What Women Want
description: A freak accident gives a Chicago advertising executive (Mel Gibson) the ability to read women's minds.

title: Sabrina
description: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: The King's Speech
description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

title: The English Patient
description: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

title: The Core
description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth.

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

title: Big Night
description: Two Italian brothers hope to save their failing restaurant by preparing a feast for bandleader Louis Prima.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: Jackass: The Movie
description: Nitwits (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Chris Pontius) perform outrageous stunts and pull practical jokes on an unsuspecting public.

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
description: A British war reporter (Stephen Dillane) becomes obsessed with an orphanage near the front lines in 1992.

title: The Doors
description: UCLA film student Jim Morrison (Val Kilmer) finds a girlfriend (Meg Ryan), forms a band and turns tragic 1960s rock star.

title: The Perfect Score
description: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

title: The School of Rock
description: Fired from his group and desperate for money, a guitarist (Jack Black) poses as a teacher for students who play in a school band.
